messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: service=rate-limiter-prod severity=critical
incident-bot: AlertID=PD-87321 triggered by quota-mapper (unexpected enforcement)
incident-bot: Symptoms: 429 spikes across multiple tenants, 40% increase in client errors in last 2m

pagerduty-bot: PD incident created: PD-87321. Primary: maria (oncall). Escalation: jon -> carol.

maria (oncall): Acked PD-87321, jumping in. Any initial context?

jon (eng): Seeing schema mismatch in quota attributes coming from the new fan-out router. It tagged some requests tenant_id=null which caused quota lookup to default to restrictive policy.

lee (infra): Logs show limiter pool dropping connections around 1960023400..1960023500. Memory for map-indexer spiked then OOM-killed one limiter instance and autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough.

carol (sre): Impact: traffic from NA region -> 429s for ~3% of requests overall but some tenants see >70% error rate. CS reported 2 live customers impacted (chatbot and search).

customer-success: Confirmed. Customer A (acme-ai) reported failed inference requests, elevated errors in their dashboard. They're on Dedicated. Need ETA for mitigation.

maria (oncall): Steps: 1) disable quota-mapper rule fallback; 2) scale limiter pool manually; 3) notify PD and customers. Who can toggle fallback now?

jon (eng): I can patch the quota-mapper flag to stop applying "default_restrictive" fallback. Applying now:
```
curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/flags/quota-mapper --data '{"default_restrictive":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS'
```
jon (eng): Response 200. Pushing config to 3 control-plane nodes.

lee (infra): Manually added 4 limiter replicas to the limiter-asg, stepping up capacity. Scaling action started: asg-scale 8->12.

incident-bot: Action log: config.toggle(default_restrictive=false) by jon (1960023540)
incident-bot: Action log: asg.scale(limiter-asg, +4) by lee (1960023565)

carol (sre): Observability: 429 rate dropped from 40%->5% over next 90s. KV cache hit rate back to normal. But a few tenants still show errors — likely cached bad lookup keys.

maria (oncall): Run a targeted cache invalidation for quota-mapper for affected tenants: tenant ids provided by CS: acme-ai (t-221), beta-inc (t-883).

jon (eng): Invalidating keys now: `redis-cli --scan --pattern "quota:*t-221*" | xargs redis-cli del` 
jon (eng): Done. Verified with `GET quota:t-221` -> nil, subsequent requests hit correct policy.

customer-success: Customer A confirms recovery for most calls. They report a short window of failed inferences. Asking for incident summary and cause.

maria (oncall): Root cause (prelim): fan-out router introduced a path that omitted tenant_id header when downstreaming to quota-mapper. Quota-mapper fallback default was restrictive, causing misapplied throttles. Secondary failure mode: limiter pod OOM reduced capacity and delayed autoscaling, compounding errors.

carol (sre): Mitigations completed: 1) revert fan-out change (roll back PR #4321), 2) set safe default on quota-mapper to permissive until validated, 3) add health-check to limiter process to prevent noisy OOM restarts, 4) add faster autoscale policy for limiter-asg.

jon (eng): PR rollback merged and deployed to canaries at 1960023650. Will promote to all once canary shows green for 5m.

lee (infra): Autoscale tweak applied: scale-up threshold lowered to 50% CPU and cooldown 30s. Also increased limiter memory to avoid immediate OOM.

incident-bot: PD-87321 status: acknowledged -> in_progress. Notes: disable default_restrictive, manual scaling, cache invalidation, rollback PR-4321.

maria (oncall): Filing action items: 1) add test for tenant header propagation (jon), 2) change quota-mapper fallback to permissive behind flag (jon), 3) limiter OOM root cause postmortem (lee + carol), 4) customer communication draft (customer-success). Assigning owners.

carol (sre): Will draft PagerDuty postmortem entry. For now: severity=sev2 (customer-impacting but mitigated).

customer-success: Draft sent to maria for review. Customers requested a short summary and timestamped timeline.

maria (oncall): Timeline (short): 1960023400 alert triggered -> 1960023540 flag toggle -> 1960023565 scale -> 1960023650 rollback -> 1960023690 errors largely resolved. Preparing communication.

jon (eng): Follow-ups: add unit/integration tests for quota header, add canary flaps for fan-out router changes, and add alert to detect sudden tenant_id=null rates.

carol (sre): Closing notes: keep PD-87321 open until postmortem is published and customers acknowledged. Great quick responses, especially cache invalidation + manual scaling. :thumbsup:

maria (oncall): Thanks all — handing off to carol for postmortem. I'll stay available for customer questions.

incident-bot: PD-87321: oncall handoff complete -> assignee=carol (1960023699)
